# Verified on this machine, 2026-11-05.
#
# Every version below was installed into a clean venv on Python 3.14.7
# (CPython, 64-bit, Windows) and imported successfully. camb was
# additionally RUN, not merely imported, because importing a Fortran
# extension proves little:
#
#   camb.set_params(H0=67.5, ombh2=0.022, omch2=0.122, ns=0.965, As=2e-9)
#   -> rdrag = 146.989 Mpc, thetastar = 1.04465
#
# Those are the same two figures the sibling repository records, from an
# independently built venv. The agreement is the check.
#
# Reproduce with:
#   python -m venv .venv
#   .venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r env/requirements.txt
#   .venv/Scripts/python -I -c "import camb; ..."   # as above

numpy==2.5.4
scipy==1.18.1
matplotlib==3.11.2
pandas==3.1.1
astropy==8.0.2
sympy==1.14.0
emcee==3.1.6
corner==2.3.0
getdist==1.7.7
dynesty==3.1.0
iminuit==2.33.0
camb==2.0.5
cobaya==3.6.2

# Pinned identically to the sibling repository on purpose. The two
# programmes should not disagree because of a library version.

# NOT AVAILABLE on this platform, each tried and recorded:
#
# classy  - the CLASS Python wrapper. pip reports no distribution for any
#           version. Source-only, needs a C toolchain. camb substitutes for
#           every use in this plan: transfer functions, CMB spectra,
#           theta_star, sound horizon.
#
# healpy  - "Failed to build installable wheels". healpy does not support
#           Windows; it needs HEALPix and cfitsio built natively. No work
#           package here requires map-level analysis: WP-6 uses published
#           f_NL constraints, and WP-3 uses the compressed plik_lite
#           likelihood at the spectrum level. If a package ever needs
#           pixel-space maps, it does not run on this machine and the plan
#           must say so rather than working around it.
#
# clik    - the Planck likelihood C code that cobaya's non-native
#           planck_2018_* components wrap. Not attempted: it does not build
#           on Windows. Use the pure-Python variants instead, which is what
#           cobaya-install fetched:
#             planck_2018_highl_plik.TTTEEE_lite_native
#             planck_2018_lowl.TT_native
#           WP-3 is written against plik_lite, so this costs nothing.
#
# Do not add any of the three to this file without installing it
# successfully and recording how.
